President Donald Trump’s net approval fell to minus 22.4 in Nate Silver’s tracker on Thursday, its lowest point across either of his White House terms. [...] ## What To Know

Silver said Trump’s latest net rating was below every point in his first term, including the period after the January 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol.

At day 612 of the current presidency, the tracker put him at minus 22.4, against minus 11.6 on the comparable day in 2018.
